purpose: Signals-only, pre-outcome DEV diagnostics for G0 Amendment 7; no strategy outcomes, exits, costs, or verification run.

barsAndRangeDiagnostics.validRangeDefinition: At least one observed M30 bar in the specified clock window on that DEV EAT calendar date; no range outcomes are evaluated.
barsAndRangeDiagnostics.causeOfPriorAsianZeroSignals: A6 required the first 20 observed Asian-session bars. The observed Asian window averaged fewer than 20 bars/day in each pre-2011 DEV year (yearly means are recorded below), so the guard skipped every entry; the corrected A7 evaluator ranges all observed bars in Asian clock window 01:00–10:59 and no longer requires 20 bars.
